relationships.subject: multiple lesion inductions
relationships.evidence_quote: Elevated TRPV1+ and SP+ DRG remained high in the multiple induction mice at 6 weeks but not in the single induction mice

relationships.subject: multiple lesion inductions
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, more SP+ and CGRP+ DRG were detected in the multiple induction mice than in the single induction mice at 2 and 6 weeks

relationships.subject: multiple lesion inductions
relationships.evidence_quote: elevated cytokine levels returned to the pre-induction levels in the single induction mice at 6 weeks, however, they remained high in the multiple induction mice

relationships.subject: multiple lesion inductions
relationships.evidence_quote: the microglia of multiple induction mice had significantly enlarged somas in the hippocampus at 2 and 6 weeks and in the thalamus at 2 weeks

key_findings: Repeated endometriosis lesion induction causes sustained hyperalgesia, DRG TRPV1/SP/CGRP elevation, chronic peritoneal inflammation and glial activation in brain and spinal cord.
